flights.description: Dated operating legs, including both inbound and outbound flights. Flight numbers repeat across dates.

turnarounds.description: Ground stay at the focal airport linking an arriving operating leg to the next departing operating leg of the same aircraft. The overall handling start denotes the start of ground-handling coordination.

inbound_id.declaration: TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES flights(flight_id)

outbound_id.declaration: TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES flights(flight_id)

boarding_sessions.description: Flight-level boarding sessions at the origin of their associated operating leg, including legs arriving at the focal airport.

flight_id.declaration: TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES flights(flight_id)

handling_jobs.description: Ground handling work orders associated with aircraft turnarounds.

turn_id.description: Aircraft turnaround associated with the job.

job_code.description: Ground crews use CL for cabin cleaning and FU for refuelling. Catering loading is recorded under CA, and baggage loading under BL. DP identifies passenger disembarkation, while UL identifies baggage unloading.

started_at.description: Actual start time of the assigned job.

finished_at.description: Time at which completion of the assigned operation was confirmed.

posted_at.description: Time at which the job record was posted to the system.

service_provider_code.description: Provider assigned to the job. Codes cover airline ground operations and contracted providers.

priority_code.description: Dispatch priority assigned to the job. STANDARD, HIGH and CRITICAL are operational priority categories.

work_zone_code.description: Zone where the work was carried out, such as aircraft cabin, cargo hold, ramp or passenger bridge.

movement_reports.description: Estimated and actual movement messages for operating legs. Actual OUT and AIR refer to the origin; LAND and IN refer to the destination. EST estimates origin off-block.

kind.description: EST = estimated off-block; OUT = actual off-block; AIR = actual take-off; LAND = actual landing; IN = actual in-block.

source_code.description: Origin of the report, such as an airport operations database (AODB), a ground handling system (GHS), or an aircraft communications feed (ACARS).

validation_code.description: How a report was checked. AUTO_CHECKED means automated checks. OPS_REVIEWED means operations staff reviewed it.

message_format_code.description: Format of the ingested record, such as AIDX, MVT or a local system record.

record_locator.description: Six-character synthetic reservation reference (PNR locator), independent of the internal booking key.

sales_channel.description: Channel used to place the reservation: WEB, MOBILE, AGENCY or CONTACT_CENTER.

booking_status.description: Reservation status in the final snapshot; CONFIRMED means the itinerary was reserved.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency of the booking amounts.

base_fare_amount.description: Total base fare in whole KRW, summed over tickets in this booking.

tax_amount.description: Total taxes and fees in whole KRW, summed over tickets.

total_amount.description: Total fare plus taxes in whole KRW.

payment_status.description: Payment state at the reservation snapshot. PAID indicates settled payment.

passengers.description: Passenger register. A single nationality is recorded, distinct from country of birth, residence or passport issuance.

passenger_id.description: Internal passenger identifier, distinct from a passport number.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format.

nationality_code.declaration: TEXT CHECK (nationality_code IS NULL OR length(nationality_code)=2)
nationality_code.description: Recorded two-letter nationality code (KR, JP, US, DE or SG). NULL means unknown.

gender_code.description: Source gender code using the local values MALE, FEMALE and UNKNOWN.

given_name.description: Fictional given name; part of the display name.

family_name.description: Fictional family name; part of the display name.

preferred_language.description: Two-letter service language code, not necessarily the passenger nationality.

loyalty_tier.description: Synthetic frequent-flyer tier; NULL means no tier recorded.

ticket_number.description: Synthetic 13-digit electronic document number using a dummy prefix; not valid for travel.

ticket_status.description: Ticket document snapshot status; ISSUED means the ticket exists, not that every coupon was flown.

issuing_channel.description: Distribution channel through which this document was issued.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency for the ticket fare.

base_fare_amount.description: Ticket base fare in whole KRW, summed across its segments.

tax_amount.description: Ticket tax and fee total in whole KRW.

total_amount.description: Ticket base fare plus taxes in whole KRW.

fare_product.description: Commercial fare product: ECONOMY_SAVER, ECONOMY_FLEX or BUSINESS.

passenger_legs.description: Ticketed segments linking a passenger ticket to a particular operating leg.

coupon_no.description: One-based coupon position in chronological order within the ticket itinerary.

booking_class.description: Reservation booking class code for the segment, using local synthetic Y, M or J values.

cabin_class.description: Cabin associated with the fare product: ECONOMY or BUSINESS.

fare_basis.description: Local synthetic fare basis code for the segment.

seat_no.description: Assigned seat designator. NULL means no seat assignment in the observed departure records.

checkin_sequence.description: Sequence of successful check-in within the dated flight; NULL if no completed check-in exists.

departure_status.description: Departure-system snapshot derived from observed processing: BOOKED, CHECKED_IN or BOARDED.

checked_bag_allowance.description: Number of included checked bags; additional paid bags can exceed the allowance.

segment_base_fare.description: Allocated segment base fare in whole KRW.

segment_tax.description: Allocated segment taxes and fees in whole KRW.

passenger_actions.description: Departure processing records for passenger flight legs.

action_code.description: Once check-in is completed, the system records CK. When boarding is confirmed, the system records BD. If a scan is rejected, the system records RJ.

station_code.description: Three-letter airport code where the processing action occurred.

processing_channel.description: WEB, MOBILE, KIOSK, COUNTER or GATE; reflects the system channel.

terminal_code.description: Synthetic terminal designation; NULL for remote web/mobile check-in.

device_id.description: Local synthetic processing device or application identifier.

result_code.description: Processing result in the source system: OK or REJECTED.

rejection_reason.description: Local synthetic reason code for a rejected boarding scan; NULL for successful actions.

bag_legs.description: Transport records for checked bags associated with passenger flight legs.

leg_id.description: Passenger flight leg associated with the checked bag.

tag_license_plate.description: Ten-digit synthetic bag-tag license plate using dummy carrier prefix 0999; not an issued tag.

weight_kg.description: Measured checked-bag mass in kilograms, synthetic.

bag_type.description: Physical baggage category: STANDARD, OVERSIZE or SPECIAL.

origin_station.description: Three-letter airport code of the associated operating leg's origin.

destination_station.description: Three-letter airport code of the associated operating leg's destination.

handling_status.description: Last observed tracking state: ACCEPTED or LOADED. No arrival or delivery is inferred.

bag_scans.description: Individual baggage tracking records for checked bags.

bag_leg_id.description: Baggage transport record associated with the scan.

scan_code.description: Baggage tracking event code. B101 indicates that a bag has been accepted. B204 indicates that a bag has been loaded into the aircraft hold.

scanned_at.description: Date and time of the baggage scan.

station_code.description: Airport where tracking observation was recorded.

location_code.description: Local tracking location: BAG_DROP or AIRCRAFT_LOADING.

device_id.description: Synthetic scanner identifier local to the station and location.

capture_method.description: Tracking capture method: BARCODE or RFID.

container_id.description: Synthetic cart/container reference for a loading observation; NULL if not recorded.

source_system.description: Local baggage reconciliation or handling system identifier.

terminal_code.description: Synthetic terminal designation at the airport represented by zone.

checkpoint_type.description: Passenger checkpoint category used in this benchmark.

lane_count.description: Number of modeled screening lanes at this checkpoint.

operational_status.description: Checkpoint availability in the master-data snapshot.

security_visits.description: Airport-provided records of individual passenger visits to security checkpoints.

queue_type.description: Local service queue category: STANDARD or PRIORITY.

lane_no.description: Synthetic lane number; NULL when screening has not started.

visit_status.description: Last observed visit state: QUEUED, IN_SCREENING or COMPLETED; does not assert a security clearance decision.

security_events.description: Observations recorded during security checkpoint visits.

point.description: Q = queue entry; S = screening start; C = screening completion.

observed_at.description: Time the observation was made on site.

received_at.description: Time the receiving system received the record.

station_code.description: Airport code of the visit checkpoint.

device_id.description: Synthetic observation device reference, not a real airport installation.

capture_method.description: Local observation capture method: SENSOR or SYSTEM_RECORD.

quality_code.description: Local record quality indicator: VALIDATED or UNREVIEWED.
